stages.creative:
Create a Book and Quill as a standalone inventory item for a grounded dark-fantasy survival world.

Do not reproduce or imitate the original Minecraft or Mineclonia sprite. Invent a fresh interpretation.

A practical blank journal with hand-bound pages and a simple writing quill integrated as part of the carried item. Worn cover, uneven paper and utilitarian binding.

Take broad creative freedom with the exact shape, proportions, construction and surface character. Favor a memorable, materially convincing design over a conservative redraw.

Grounded dark-fantasy material realism: tactile, weathered, muted and physically believable; restrained saturation, soft diffuse illumination and controlled detail. No glossy mobile-game icon look, cartoon rendering, enlarged pixel art or unnecessary fantasy ornament.

Exactly one complete isolated item with comfortable empty space around it.

Output on REAL TRANSPARENCY (alpha = 0). Never draw a checkerboard, transparency grid, background, environment, pedestal, text, border, UI or cast shadow. Everything outside the item must be fully transparent.
stages.correction:
IMAGE A = original Mineclonia item.
IMAGE B = new creative design.

Keep Image B's design, materials and details.

Recompose Image B to match Image A's position on the canvas, occupied area and scale, orientation and viewing angle, and approximate silhouette footprint.

Image A controls composition and pose. Image B controls the actual design.

Do not copy Image A's surface design or pixel details.

Output only the isolated item on REAL TRANSPARENCY (alpha = 0). Do not draw a checkerboard, transparency grid, background, shadow, or any background pixels. Everything outside the item must be fully transparent.
